definition: a huge, unstoppable force or institution that crushes everything in its path
hook: The crushing you picture never happened quite the way the story says.
modernAnchor: We call a hit franchise or a landslide election a juggernaut, an unstoppable, crushing force.
journey: Jagannath, lord of the universe, is a Hindu deity pulled through Puri on an enormous wooden chariot.
British colonial visitors watched the crowds and claimed devotees hurled themselves under the wheels to die.
Historians now doubt that claim, calling it a colonial exaggeration of accidental deaths during a chaotic festival.
The myth stuck anyway. Juggernaut came to mean an unstoppable crushing force, not a universal lord.
